claims.statement: Tom Allen (printed as 'Tom ei') advertised his place at 619 Market street, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Tom ei, retired charmpion pugilist of the world. 619 Market street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen (printed as 'Tom ei') advertised a free concert every evening at his place.
claims.excerpt: Free concert every evening. Only first-class singers engaged here.

claims.statement: Tom Allen (printed as 'Tom ei') was advertised as a retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom ei, retired charmpion pugilist of the world.

notes: Advertisement only. The name is printed as 'Tom ei'; read as Tom Allen from the address and wording.
